SrcPattern: LISTAGG(<value: STRING, COLUMN>, <sep: OPTION['\', \'', '\';\'']>) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY <value> <order_rule: OPTION['ASC', 'DESC']>)

SELECT <group_by_cols: LIST[ANY_VALUE]>,  
{for <aggr_function>,<value>,<first_last>,<order_column> in <aggr_functions: LIST[OPTION['MIN', 'MAX', 'SUM', 'AVG', 'COUNT', 'VARIANCE', 'STDDEV']]>, <values:  LIST[NUMBER]>,  <first_lasts: LIST[OPTION['FIRST': 'ASC','LAST': 'DESC']]>, <order_columns: LIST[ANY_VALUE]> ADD ',':
            <aggr_function>(<value>) KEEP (DENSE_RANK <first_last> ORDER BY <order_column> ASC)
}
  FROM <tables: LIST[TABLE]>
  WHERE <cond: ANY_VALUE>
  GROUP BY <group_by_cols>
TgtPattern:
WITH <alias1: ALIAS> AS (
    SELECT {for <g_col>, <g_alias> in <group_by_cols>, <g_alias_list: LIST[ALIAS]> ADD ',': <g_col> AS <g_alias>}, 
{for <value>, <alias> in <values>, <value_aliases: LIST[ALIAS]> ADD ',':<value> AS <alias>},
{for <order_column>, <first_last>, <alias> in <order_columns>, <first_lasts>, <aliases: LIST[ALIAS]> ADD ',':
DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY {for <col> in <group_by_cols> ADD ',': <col>} ORDER BY <order_column> <first_last>) AS <alias>}
      FROM <tables>      
      WHERE <cond>
)
SELECT <g_alias_list>,
        {for <aggr_function>, <value_alias>, <alias> in <aggr_functions>, <value_aliases>, <aliases> ADD ',':
       <aggr_function>(CASE WHEN <alias> = 1 THEN <value_alias> END)}
  FROM <alias1>
 GROUP BY <g_alias_list>
